purpose: Saved embedding-level ANLP results; no new models or probes trained by this compilation

primary_comparison.geometry_distance: squared Euclidean on float64-renormalized L2 embeddings
primary_comparison.apd: mean squared L2 distance between anchor and positive on the fixed triplets
primary_comparison.negative_distance: mean squared L2 distance between anchor and negative on the fixed triplets
primary_comparison.msg: mean negative minus positive squared L2 distance on the fixed triplets
primary_comparison.alignment: mean squared L2 distance of fixed same-event cross-ideology positive pairs
primary_comparison.uniformity: log mean exp(-2 times squared L2) for fixed article pairs

probe_protocol.selection: max validation macro-F1; tie: lower weight decay, then earlier epoch
probe_protocol.preprocessing: saved L2-normalized embeddings only; no scaler or PCA
probe_protocol.test_use: once per seed after validation-only selection

triplet_lambda035_first_token_attraction.display_name: Attraction triplet, first token, margin 0.2, beta 0.3, tau 0.5

article_stratified_and_publisher_held_ou.scope: legacy cross-validation; distinct from fixed train/val/test probe protocol

permutation.method: globally permute ideology labels once; reuse stratified fold indices; fit pipeline anew
globally permute ideology labels once; reuse stratified fold indices; fit pipeline anew

smaller_common_subset_probes.scope: 1,167-article common subset; do not mix with full-cohort scores

protocol.selection: max validation macro-F1; tie: lower weight decay, then earlier epoch
protocol.preprocessing: saved L2-normalized embeddings only; no scaler or PCA
protocol.test_use: once per seed after validation-only selection

manifest.selection: Seeded sample without replacement per ideology; rows sorted by source order
manifest.base_description: pretrained LED before ANLP task training; not randomly initialized

first_token_distance_diagnostics.scope: 100 diagnostic triplets; ordinary Euclidean distances; separate from full-cohort APD

result.distance: squared Euclidean distance on float64-renormalized embeddings

earlier_first_token_triplet_comparison.scope: same fixed 2,000 triplets; includes paired bootstrap comparison of first-token and masked-mean MSG

result.candidate_policy: all opposite-ideology test articles, stable source-order tie break

earlier_pretrained_test_extraction_retri.scope: same held-out articles; pretrained checkpoint extracted separately on test articles

limitations: Legacy cross-validation and smaller-subset probe scores use different samples or protocols; compare within their sections only.
The fixed 2,000-triplet APD and MSG are squared Euclidean embedding metrics; training triplet losses use ordinary Euclidean distances.
Embedding metrics alone do not establish neutrality or factual preservation of generated text.
